staff.description: Stores clinical and support personnel profiles, qualifications, and recent workload counters

name.description: Full name of the healthcare professional

role.description: Clinical role: Doctor, Nurse, Lab Tech, Pharmacist, Radiologist

department.description: Assigned unit: Emergency, Intensive Care Unit (ICU), Pediatrics, Surgery, General Ward

qualifications.description: List of certifications and skills, e.g. ['BLS', 'ACLS', 'Triage']

currentWorkloadScore.description: Integer counter representing cumulative shifts worked. Lower score indicates less fatigue and higher priority for replacement.

phoneNumber.description: Contact number for simulated shift notifications

createdAt.description: Date and time the staff member record was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time the staff member record was last updated

shifts.description: Hospital shift assignments, timing, and staffing requirements

date.description: Shift calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format

requiredRole.description: Required clinical role for this shift (e.g. Nurse)

assignedStaffId.description: ID of the staff member assigned to this shift, or empty if unassigned

notes.description: Optional notes regarding shift handover or special requirements

attendance.description: Shift clock-in and availability check records

shiftId.description: Reference to the shifts collection document

staffId.description: Reference to the staff collection document

status.description: Attendance status: present, late, absent, unavailable

timestamp.description: Time the attendance was recorded by the supervisor

markedBy.description: Supervisor email who logged this status

reason.description: Stated reason if absent or unavailable

leaveRequests.description: Time-off and emergency leave requests submitted by staff

staffId.description: Reference to the staff collection document

startDate.description: Leave start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

endDate.description: Leave end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

reason.description: Reason provided by staff (e.g. Medical, Family, Study)

reviewedBy.description: Supervisor identifier who reviewed the request

reassignmentLogs.description: Audit trail logging supervisor replacement decisions with candidate rankings

newStaffId.description: Replacement staff ID chosen by supervisor

recommendationRank.description: Rank position of the chosen candidate (1st, 2nd, etc.)

reasonSummary.description: Explanation why candidate was eligible (e.g., department match, low workload)
